This document lists the equipment inspection I2, which must be 
performed on every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz El Bagoury and tested by: eng. Doaa Anis and 
revised by quality control eng. Adel Abdel Kader el Nagar at EDECo. and accepted 
by general director eng. Mahmoud Saker and approved by eng.Mostafa Alam Head 
Sector of Talkha PS

The 
first update 
initiated by eng.Azza elsaid abd elsamiea and tested by: eng Esraa abd elrhem and revised by 
quality control eng. Adel Abdel Kader el Nagar at MDEP.and accepted by general 
director eng. Metwaly Said elhendawy and approved by eng. Farok awad Head Sector 
of Talkha PS.

This document 
accepted by eng Samir abd elgilil inspection quality control general director 
and MPIS Coordinator and eng Mohammed nagib Head Sector of quality control.

A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

items:
Use standard personal safety 
 and healthy
 equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 goggles, protective clothing, rubber gloves

The door of the battery room must be provided 
 with NO Smoking signs .

The battery instructions must be displayed 
 visibly on the wall..

Water source must be available in the battery 
 room.

When working in the battery room bewares of 
 parts under voltage.
Disconnect DC switch of the battery from the main bus bar
Suitable tool set.
Hydrometer.
Digital voltmeter.
Thermometer
Vaseline

Keep the batteries clean and dry protect them against solid, liquid and 
 gaseous contamination.
Disconnect AC supply to Battery charger
Inspect terminals of battery and clean any salt deposits with distilled water.
Clean battery room floor with water.
Clean top of the cells.
Check for correct operation of battery room ventilation fan.
Check acid level 10 mm above separators or between max / min levels.
Write down the voltage temperature and acid density of pilot cells.
Read over all voltage of bank and record on battery maintenance card.
Inspect the outside of cells for cracks and leakage electrolyte.
Check that the screws are well tightened 10 NM of cu poles.
Protect the cell connectors and screws against corrosion using Vaseline.
Measure the internal resistance of the battery by protection group.

Connect the switch of the battery to auxiliary bus bar and discharge it for 10 
 hours until acid density reachs 1.11g/cm3.
Place battery bank on float charge for 10 hours until acid density is 1.24 g/cm3.

When step No 13 is completed place selector switch to normal charge and return 
 battery bank to regular service.
Compare the reading you have taken to the readings recorded in previous years.
